L-1.if_positive: declarative recipe; feeds the move alphabet
L-1.method: Re-Pair/Sequitur on register-renamed k-grams; extract rule set; replay
L-1.pass_bar: one rule set <= 200 rules regenerates >= 3 skeletons exactly; cross-word rule overlap >= 90%
L-1.question: Is the A/B skeleton a parametric D0L with position-independent rules?
L-1.title: Skeleton grammar

L-3.method: lag-match spectra and autocorrelation per alphabet
L-3.pass_bar: a peak z >= 5 over N1b at a lag explained by a named parameter (current: multiples of 4 only)
L-3.question: Periods tied to h=9, 8 centres, 22, v=112, 73, 666?
L-3.title: Periodicity census

L-4.if_positive: frames readable from the skeleton; negative confirms frames are global
L-4.null_model: strings permuted among registers of the same role (358 distinct vs 56)
L-4.pass_bar: >= 90% exact prediction on the held-out word vs <= 50% null
L-4.question: Is a register jump string a function of local data (role, entrance dim, width, first/last motif)?
L-4.title: Climb-string predictability

L-5.if_positive: string-level alias pre-screen on new words
L-5.method: k-gram context with rank/role; logistic or rule screen; score the 192 augmenting paths; S-1 atlas = ground truth
L-5.null_model: labels permuted; rank-only features (the floor rule) as baseline
L-5.pass_bar: AUC >= 0.9 held-out AND the two realised moves (401->564, 403->565) in the top 5 of 192 beyond the floor rule
L-5.question: Does a local motif around (lender last gate, follower first gate) add information beyond the exact lo/hi rule?
L-5.title: Alias-feasibility motif

algorithm.early_cap: Reaching 201 produced rules makes the <=200-rule condition false; the capped algorithm is the registered search protocol, not an exact minimum-grammar solver.
algorithm.name: joint deterministic binary RePair
algorithm.pair_choice: Largest overlapping adjacent-pair count summed over the three separate words; ties by lexicographic terminal/nonterminal pair IDs. Replace greedily left-to-right without crossing word boundaries. Stop if fewer than two replacements are possible.
algorithm.terminal_ids: First occurrence while scanning the three words in the registered path order

anti_memorization.interpretation: Stored axioms can encode the observed output. A numerical PASS alone does not establish a parametric D0L family; independent parameterized axioms and productions remain a proof obligation.

L1.artifact_policy: Retain input/script hashes, triple ID, rule count, exact-replay flags, overlap values, axiom lengths and residual counts for all triples. Full NULL axioms/terminal dictionaries may be omitted from committed summaries after hashing; preserve a complete PASS witness if one exists.
L1.exactness: Expand each word axiom through the shared rule dictionary and compare every terminal ID with the original declared skeleton sequence.
L1.failure_handling: A missing/error/timeout triple prevents an all-triples NULL. An exact witness can establish the existential numerical PASS; all incomplete work and seed consistency must still be reported.
L1.method: For each of all 84 fixed triples, use string_screen.shared_grammar on globally first-occurrence register-renamed and signed-warp-operator-renamed rank-annotated A/B skeletons. The algorithm, token definitions and triple list are fixed before observations.
L1.optional_all_nine_fit: Descriptive only, if run within the registered budget. It cannot replace the existential 84-triple decision.
L1.overlap: For every pair of the three words, Jaccard overlap of all transitively used shared-rule IDs must be >=0.90. Report all three values.
L1.pass_bar_verbatim: one rule set <= 200 rules regenerates >= 3 skeletons exactly; cross-word rule overlap >= 90%
L1.primary_decision: A triple passes iff its shared rule count <=200, all three skeletons replay exactly and all three pairwise rule-use overlaps >=0.90. L-1 passes iff at least one of the 84 registered triples passes. L-1 is NULL only if all 84 evaluable triples fail, confirmed by the second seed.
remaining_pattern_obligations: N1 and applicable stronger null margins
cross-family replication or declared family-local replication
L1.scope_of_null: Failure of the fixed capped RePair algorithm on the 84 registered triples only. It does not prove that another grammar or a parametric D0L construction cannot exist.
L1.seed_semantics: The exact fit is deterministic; rerun under the second seed to verify the same numerical decision and retain both receipts. No permutation p-value is assigned to the exact gate.
L1.warp_handling: Retain all recorded forward warps associated with those sections, including B warps after the last B gate. Do not include cut, cleanup, compensation or restore in this grammar target.

L3.decision_constraints: A named-lag peak z>=5 over N1b is necessary, together with q<=0.05 in the complete 864 family. z alone never establishes a finding. Pattern status additionally requires all PLAN section 6 criteria, including >=3-word replication, applicable effect margins and genuinely held-out confirmation. Report any zero-SD null explicitly rather than inventing a finite z.
L3.descriptive_autocorrelation: For each section and lag, center the one-hot category vectors using that section's full unigram frequencies p. Sum e_i dot e_(i+L) - p[x_i] - p[x_(i+L)] + sum(p^2), divided by (n-L)*(1-sum(p^2)); pool numerators/denominators across A/B for a pooled descriptive value. A constant string has undefined covariance normalization. No extra q-values are assigned to these diagnostics.

family.fdr: BH at 0.05 across these 864 cells separately within each seed; do not merge with, replace, or expand the 540-cell core family.
family.null_protocol: Use the same registered whole-forward section shuffle or exact commuting-window sweep as M0/M1, then measure A/B only. Cut randomization is ignored by the statistic; its fixed RNG consumption is retained.
family.score: Higher within-section lag match is stronger; empirical p=(1+count(null>=real))/2001.

L3.implementation: word_periods.lag_batch; word_periods.prepare_template in parent then word_periods.template_census through pool.py. Definition is complete; execute only if the Lane A stop permits continuation.
L3.pass_bar_verbatim: a peak z >= 5 over N1b at a lag explained by a named parameter (current: multiples of 4 only)
L3.primary_statistic: For each alphabet and lag L, count equal-token pairs separately within A and within B, sum the two counts, and divide by max(0,|A|-L)+max(0,|B|-L). No pair crosses a section boundary; cut, cleanup and compensation are excluded. Include prelude and B warps as ordinary canonical events.

alphabets.literal: Injective typed tuple serialization of each entire JSON instruction, preserving all operands.
alphabets.opcode: (outer tag, scalar-operation name) for scalar records; (outer tag,) for other records.

template_census.measurements: For each orientation/alphabet, instruction count, instruction-kind histogram, fixed-lag equality/autocorrelation census and categorical periodogram at the same eight periods.
template_census.provenance: Read with python -I -B, never import/execute instructions. Record compressed file SHA256 and Git blob plus #2802 PINS lineage attribution. Load the template once in the parent, with optional reuse of its already-loaded object.
template_census.schema: local_programs.forward and local_programs.backward are ordered tagged JSON instruction lists. Scalar records contain a scalar-operation list and a rank; phase and other tags remain literal instructions.
template_census.status: EXPLORATORY descriptive component of L-3; no p or q. Complete literal programs contain derived phases, and backward is not an independent construction replicate.

L4.leakage_exclusion: Do not use paid dt/ds fields from first/last motifs; they overlap the target climb labels.
L4.model: Deterministic exact-feature lookup with majority label, lexicographic label tie-break, and role-majority fallback for unseen features.
L4.multiplicity: Separate fixed family of 12 per-word accuracy tests, BH at 0.05 within each seed; leave-one-PR-out sensitivity descriptive. No combination with the 540-screen q-values.
L4.null: Independently permute entire climb-string labels within each word and role, then refit every leave-one-word-out and leave-one-PR-group-out fold.
L4.pass_bar_verbatim: >= 90% exact prediction on the held-out word vs <= 50% null
L4.pattern_requirement: Even a passed prediction bar remains a candidate until N2 non-circularity and the genuinely held-out M4 check are satisfied.
L4.primary_aggregation: Report the >=0.90 real exact accuracy and <=0.50 matched-null mean threshold per held-out word; an all-word claim requires every registered file to meet the bar. Report a qualifying subset separately, subject to >=3-word and family criteria, without substituting it for the all-word result.
L4.target: Entire ordered tuple of positive per-register paid climb ranks, including any registered centre descent children.
L4.validation: Leave one word file out; fit only on other files. Also report predeclared leave-one-PR-group-out sensitivity, grouping base/extra variants together.

L5.auc_evaluation: Enumerate all life-slot pairs excluding a private register paired to itself. Label by exact adjacency and score with the same fixed motif edge rule. Report per-variant motif AUC and exact-guard AUC; these are guard-label diagnostics, not independent realized-outcome evidence. No unselected augmenting path is labeled negative.

baselines.exact_guard: Feasibility labels are the exact time/floor-ceiling adjacency rule, so its AUC is exactly 1 where both classes exist; every legal candidate path ties at score 1.
baselines.floor_slack: Additional fixed ranking diagnostic: negative sum of (life ceiling - slot floor) over the two compatibility edges. Report the same exact tie intervals. It is not used in the motif score.

L5.decision: Record the two realized-path top-5 predicates and the AUC>=0.9 numerical predicate separately. Missing distinct realized-outcome labels prevents a claim of incremental predictive information beyond the exact guard. If a necessary top-5 condition demonstrably fails under the fixed tie rule, report that scoped ranking NULL; otherwise the complete beyond-floor L-5 question remains EXPLORATORY until its missing outcome evidence exists. Both seeds must reproduce any decision.
L5.edge_score: Form multisets of all contiguous 1-,2-,3-grams within each of the two context strings. Similarity is exact rational Dice: 2*sum_g min(count_exit[g],count_entry[g])/(total_exit_ngrams+total_entry_ngrams). If either context is empty the score is 0. This fixed unsupervised rule is evaluated without fitting to feasibility labels.
L5.evaluation_units: The historical pre-host-move refit7 base word is the primary 192-path ranking unit; the extra variant is a predeclared sensitivity unit, not an independent construction family. The scorer is fixed and unsupervised: no examples, labels or realized moves are used to fit it. This is not the M4 held-out check.
L5.implementation: word_alias_score.prepare in parent, then word_alias_score.task through pool.py. All graph/data objects are cached in the parent; execution only if Lane A remains active.
L5.missing_outcomes: The other 190 paths have no failure labels merely because they were unselected. Feasibility labels are circular with the exact baseline and leave zero AUC-improvement headroom. Report this limitation explicitly rather than manufacture labels or substitute an easier claim.
L5.motif_definition: For a slot, use its last three scalar A/B/restore touches ending at its own-life last event, without crossing a warp. For a life, use its first three scalar touches starting at its first event, ending before any later warp. Keep chronological order. Token=(operation,exact reduced signed coefficient,frame rank,target role,source role), replacing the focal register role by SELF and classifying other registers only as P/T/C/H. Never include numerical register IDs, positions/times, exact floors/ceilings, paid climbs, labels, realized-move identity or later-stage data.

null.description: Independently permute the actual pair feasibility labels within each word, preserving class counts, and reuse the fixed motif/exact-guard score ranks. No path-outcome permutation is possible without path outcomes.
null.family: base/extra x motif/exact-guard AUC; BH at 0.05 per seed, separate from both string families.

L5.pass_bar_verbatim: AUC >= 0.9 held-out AND the two realised moves (401->564, 403->565) in the top 5 of 192 beyond the floor rule
L5.path_enumeration: Build matching.graph_data and adjacency from the exact pre-host census. Enumerate every length-3 alternating path: currently unmatched follower -> occupied own-life segment -> its currently hosted life -> a free slot. Verify both compatibility edges and occupied-life identity. Require exactly 192 unique paths in each registered variant; a mismatch is ERROR, not padding/truncation. Existing matching.augmenting_paths returns only one shortest path and is not used for this enumeration.
L5.path_score: Arithmetic mean of the two compatibility-edge motif similarities, represented as an exact Fraction. Score every one of the 192 paths identically before locating realized-path identities.
L5.state_reconstruction: Load each retired5 pinned word; apply only the explicit refit7 frame assignments and its declared local_profile. Recount canonically and construct exact Bounds. Record predecessor PINS attribution, patch SHA256/blob and the derived canonical-JSON SHA256. No hostmove2/alias7/final-word features enter the scorer.
L5.tie_handling: For each realized path report best rank=1+number of strictly higher scores, worst rank=number of scores >= its score, midrank, and tie count. Top-5 is demonstrated only when worst rank<=5. Hash/lexicographic identity may order a displayed tie but never break it for the decision.

conditional_controls.N1c: Report register-renaming metamorphic control; equality-only statistics are invariant to a bijective token relabelling, so identity here is not extra scientific evidence.
conditional_controls.N2: Use the validated exact-profile-preserving lattice walk. Retain accepted/attempted moves, rejected profiles, changed vertices, and degeneracy. An identity-only walk does not demonstrate non-circularity.
conditional_controls.N2b: Solve the registered optimal-frame surrogate once per word, outside permutation loops, and require a certified optimum before claiming a pattern remains present there.
conditional_controls.N4: Build and preregister constructor-synthetic words only if a candidate survives M1; this control remains a prerequisite for a constructor-level string claim.
conditional_controls.N5: Report FULL-WORD/BORROW-WORD split and predeclared family-local scope; both format families are available in the nine-word set.
conditional_controls.N6: Use the held 152 PASS-but-losing words and 142 FAIL mutants for any applicable predictive alias motif, under a separately frozen scoring protocol before examining labels.
conditional_controls.rule: Missing required controls prevent a pattern designation; do not silently redefine the pattern bar.

current_observation_boundary.L2_note: M0 L-2 v1 confirmed NULL on both seeds before M1 registration; no M1 experiment has run.

protocol.decision_confirmation: Keep distinct immutable RESULT.json receipts for both seeds. A scientific decision stands only if both seeds agree. A technical failure is ERROR/TIMEOUT; missing evidence is EXPLORATORY; neither is a scientific NULL.
protocol.definition_status: M1 continuation definitions complete; code validation and all experiments are still coordinator-owned. This draft file itself is not a preregistration receipt.

execution_and_recording.artifact_limit: Keep committed results below 200 MB; retain summaries and hashes, and preserve full witness artifacts only when needed. No raw permutation lists in final committed receipts.
execution_and_recording.cpu_caps: Screening runs <=20 core-minutes, confirmation runs <=2 core-hours, checkpoint before 2 core-hours; M1 target allocation about 6 core-hours. Preregister any division into runs before execution and retain TIMEOUT rather than changing n or silently retrying.
entrypoints: string_screen.task({experiment: L-1, paths: triple_paths, seed: seed, max_rules: 201})
string_screen.task({experiment: M1-SCREEN, path: path, seed: seed, null: N1_or_N1b, start: sample_start, n: batch_size})
string_screen.task({experiment: L-4, paths: L4_paths, seed: seed, start: sample_start, n: batch_size})
execution_and_recording.memory_projection: Before each launch record parent RSS and project parent + workers*(inherited parent + word + working set); reject a projection beyond available RAM or the worker cap.
execution_and_recording.parent_loading: Load words, control graphs, GLOBAL-TEMPLATE and any large shared objects once in the parent; workers receive indices/paths into the prepared fork-shared cache.
execution_and_recording.pool: Every parallel task goes through research/styles-r11/pipeline/pool.py.
execution_and_recording.registry: Root updates EXPERIMENTS.json planned -> running -> final status, retains both seed receipts and a confirmation record, and makes small progress commits.
execution_and_recording.solver_rule: No solver longer than 10 minutes inside a permutation loop; any MILP/LP surrogate is solved once per word outside loops.
execution_and_recording.wording: Every NULL names its fixed protocol. No kappa claim; any plausible lever is a census target in results/HANDBACK.md.

execution_order.action: Require completion of M0 and read the confirmed Lane A scientific-result history. Freeze this preregistration before fitting a grammar.
L-1 exact grammar gate: fit the same fixed deterministic capped joint RePair algorithm separately on all 84 registered triples of the nine word files, in both seed runs.
Apply the two-consecutive-NULL lane stop immediately. In particular, confirmed L-2 NULL followed by confirmed L-1 NULL stops Lane A before the 540-cell screen, L-3, L-4, L-5, and N4.
Only if Lane A remains active, execute the fixed 540-cell N1/N1b screen with 2000 samples per cell and per seed; report the motif census, period diagnostics, and N5 split.
Complete the registered L-3 A/B and template census, then apply both the screen stop and two-consecutive-NULL stop before continuing.
If still active, run L-4, confirm its decision with the second seed, and check the lane stop.
If still active, run L-5 against the S-1 atlas and real 192-path set, confirm the second seed, and check the lane stop.

Only surviving candidates receive the required N1c, N2, N2b, conditional N4, N5 and applicable N6 controls. Each surviving candidate must have a frozen exact <=1-core-hour prediction before M4 held-out data are fetched.

fixed_screen_family.N1: One independent Fisher-Yates shuffle of each section from the shipped word for every sample; preserve event-attached token fields and section lengths.
fixed_screen_family.N1b: One shuffled visitation sweep of every gate from the shipped word for every sample; choose each destination uniformly in the current exact toolkit commute/move_window interval. Use the accelerator only after its all-pair predicate and seeded output/RNG equivalence certificate.
fixed_screen_family.decision_confirmation: The same alphabet/statistic candidate and its qualifying words must meet the prescribed effect and q conditions in both independent master-seed runs.
fixed_screen_family.dependence: One sampled event permutation supplies all six alphabets and all five statistics. Dependence does not change the fixed 540 hypothesis count.
fixed_screen_family.descriptive: Report null mean/SD, empirical p, q, effect size, z and degenerate-null diagnostics. H1..H5, h1..h6, individual repeat motifs and per-period lag statistics are descriptive unless a separate family is frozen before they are run.
fixed_screen_family.effects: CR=null mean/real for lz76, repair and H6. Aggregate repeat and period enrichment=real/null mean. Report zero denominators explicitly and do not silently assign a finite ratio.
fixed_screen_family.fdr: Benjamini-Hochberg at 0.05 over exactly all 540 predeclared cell p-values within each seed. A motif-pattern claim additionally requires q<0.01. Never calculate a q-value for exploratory added tests.
fixed_screen_family.incomplete_family: A TIMEOUT/ERROR or incomplete 2000-sample cell is not a scientific NULL. Do not present FDR acceptance on a selectively completed subset as if the full family completed.
fixed_screen_family.permutation_p: (1 + count(null_score >= real_score))/(1 + 2000), where compression/entropy score=-value and enrichment score=value; never zero.
fixed_screen_family.rng: word_tasks.sample_seed(master_seed, pin_key, M1:null_name, sample_index), then Python random.Random; batch boundaries and worker scheduling do not change samples.

H6.definition: Empirical overlapping length-6 block entropy in bits; H1..H5 and h1..h6 are descriptive outputs only

lz76.definition: Kaspar-Schuster LZ76 phrase count from the Lane A implementation

maximal_repeat_mass.definition: Sum length * occurrence_count over suffix-array repeats of length >=4 and count >=3 that are left- and right-maximal; occurrences may overlap
maximal_repeat_mass.limitation: This is an aggregate repeat statistic, not a separately tested motif. Individual motif listings receive no additional q-values.

period_peak.definition: Maximum one-hot centered categorical Fourier energy over the fixed eight structural periods; normalization is n * sum_a p_a(1-p_a)
period_peak.limitation: The maximum is the one registered statistic; per-period powers, lag matches, and the argmax are diagnostics, not additional independent tests.

repair.definition: Deterministic binary RePair description size: final sequence length plus twice the rule count

fixed_screen_family.stream: Concatenated canonical forward A/cut/B, preserving section tags and including all prelude/B warps; cleanup and compensation excluded. This is the existing screen_batch stream. The additional L-3 A/B/template obligation is identified separately below.

lane_stop.conditional_example: If and only if both seeds confirm L-2 NULL and both seeds then confirm L-1 NULL, stop Lane A immediately for this round.
lane_stop.screen_stop: No (alphabet, statistic) pair with CR >=1.2 against N1b on >=3 words after M1 implies stop and a protocol-specific screen NULL. CR is null_mean/real for the lower-is-stronger compression/entropy statistics; repeat/period enrichment is reported separately and does not silently substitute for CR.
lane_stop.skipped_items: For every stopped downstream item, write an EXPLORATORY receipt with not_run=true, the stop-trigger result paths, zero permutations, and a precise skip reason. Do not fabricate a NULL or a q-value for unrun tests.
lane_stop.technical_failures: ERROR, TIMEOUT, incomplete batches, absent controls and unconfirmed seed disagreement do not count as scientific NULL.
lane_stop.two_consecutive_nulls: Count confirmed pre-registered scientific experiments within Lane A, in execution order. L-2 is the preceding Lane A experiment if confirmed; P-1/P-2 infrastructure results and Lane B/C results do not reset this sequence.
lane_stop.whole_plan: Hard stop at the end of week 2; write-up and hand-back remain required.

protocol.note: Frozen before any M1 experiment. RUNBOOK section 3 ordering and PLAN section 6 stopping rules apply.
protocol.ordering_rationale: The explicit user instruction follows RUNBOOK section 3: L-1/L-3 screen, then L-4, then L-5. The contrary priority sentence at the end of PLAN section 8 does not change that order. The exact L-1 gate is first within M1 because its necessary numerical condition can fail without a permutation inference.
pattern_criteria: reproducible on >=3 words of W including both families, or declared family-local with >=3 words of that family
CR >=1.5 vs N1 and >=1.2 vs N1b; motif enrichment >=2x at q<0.01; applicable strongest null must also be beaten
yields a falsifiable prediction checkable with the exact tools in <=1 core-hour
passes a held-out check on a word not used to find it
non-circular: not a function of local profile, rank mass or width inventory; recompute under N2 and require the statistic to move
